demo: README 'Run Qwen3' > Transformers quickstart snippet (AutoModelForCausalLM + apply_chat_template + generate), using Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B instead of the 30B model
goal: Get the README Transformers chat-generation snippet working on CPU with the small model Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B (replace the 30B model name). Python with transformers and torch (CPU) must be installed so that `python` can run a script that loads the tokenizer and model, applies the chat template to the prompt 'Give me a short introduction to large language model.', and generates text with model.generate.

issues: Content check is vacuous: `grep -qi -E "language model|model|text|AI"`. Case-insensitive 'ai' matches nearly any English text ('explain', 'contain', 'train'), so the oracle in effect only checks for >100 bytes of output, and a degenerate generation passes. v2 requires 'language model' (the prompt's topic; observed greedy output starts 'A large language model (LLM) is ...') and a minimal word-diversity check.
evidence: logs/qwenlm-qwen3/oracle.txt and replay_oracle.txt - greedy output both times: 'A large language model (LLM) is a type of artificial intelligence that can understand, generate, and respond to human language...'
